verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator with a PyTorch-based software stack. It does not host or hold user data in a service from which data would be exported, so a "data export and leave" story is a category error for this product type. The evidence on PyTorch and Hugging Face integration and the open OAM interface concerns model portability and hardware openness, not exporting user-held data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
